D1_eligibility_requirements.name: temporal_and_provenance
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: new forward-time cohort not used or looked at in any TRAIN, DEV, old G5 TEST, B1/B2 or original room diagnostics; all event IDs unique after protected local overlap checks

D1_eligibility_requirements.name: outcome_blindness
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: no target label/rank/utility read by the researchers or scripts during authorization and pretest design; any earlier exposure recorded

D1_eligibility_requirements.name: rights_and_privacy
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: clear permitted computational reuse, confidentiality, storage and derived evidence release; no unconsented re-identification

D1_eligibility_requirements.name: candidate_and_history_provenance
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: eligible full-active author roster and complete prior observable history at time t, TRAIN-known author identity as defined before outcome, no future events in Z

D1_eligibility_requirements.name: cohort_size_and_dependence
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: outcome-free event counts, distinct users, timestamp range and user overlap flags enough for user cluster statistical power feasibility

D1_eligibility_requirements.name: frozen_input_contract
D1_eligibility_requirements.criterion: frozen Base & Memory score implementation and exact eligible candidate semantics transferable without method retuning on unseen outcomes

D2_pretest_requirements.criterion: freeze central contrast same target full-active evaluation F-to-F vs pure S-to-F, and expected positive user-cluster paired NDCG difference
freeze real relation source comparison and a valid support/author-marginal-preserving placebo; measure true expert strength to avoid weak-control floor effects
freeze actual decision rules fitted and threshold-calibrated without new TEST utility, natural calls plus predeclared fair-budget sensitivity; report Always Memory

freeze primary family, correction across predefined Base comparisons, cluster unit, confidence estimator, minimum practical effect threshold justified from known DEV only (explicitly post-hoc-derived)
freeze selected two Base families & seeds, author/event cohort, all preprocessing files, SHA registries and no future sample selection after observing labels
sign/data version/report/archive checklist and locked one-shot reveal permission
